diagnosis.root_cause: BeforeQueueNode's goalBoundary isolated GOAL producer token changes only; two different queued GOAL SpriteNodes may carry the identical ResultProgress/GoalTime/OutRunStagePrintf/ResultTextB9200 token while their D3DX Draw batches are physically deferred. The prior batch may therefore submit after queue selection under the next node/epoch, conflicting with R33 binocular source identity.
